title: MSFS 2024: 2 New Marketplace Expansions You NEED to Try! (737 MAX & Norway VFR)
description:
Ready to explore two completely different flight styles in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? Perfect Flight has rolled out two brand-new activity expansions in the in-sim Marketplace, catering to both high-workload commercial airliner line operations and low-and-slow visual scenic exploration.

Whether you want to command scheduled 737 routes across North America or embark on an audio-guided prop tour across Scandinavian coastlines, we break down both add-ons to help you plan your next flight:

✈️ COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS: AMERICA 250 (SOUTHWEST AIRLINES)
First, we look at the America 250 Southwest Airlines package. Built specifically for the Boeing 737 MAX in MSFS 2024, this expansion delivers a commemorative 4th of July / America 250 livery, authentic custom aviation soundsets, a dedicated in-sim mini browser, and 12 structured line missions spanning realistic cross-country routes and historic arrivals.

🏔️ SCENIC EXPLORATION & VFR TOURS: NORWAY VFR
Next, we throttle back and head north for Norway VFR. Flown in the Beechcraft Bonanza G36, this comprehensive expedition takes you from the rugged Barents Sea headlands in Finnmark down to the inner Oslofjord. Featuring 12 detailed VFR flight legs and over 220 narrated audio recordings, you’ll get deep geographical, cultural, and historical insights over Norway's most dramatic fjords at cruising altitudes between 4,500 and 7,500 feet.

Which style are you flying first in MSFS 2024? Managing the flight deck of the 737 MAX on commercial routes, or exploring the dramatic Norwegian fjords low and slow? Let us know in the comments below!
